independence.rationale: S1 completes the schema migration, leaving inventory_code dropped and batch/serial columns populated. S2 adds the distinct behavior of exposing these fields via API responses. S1 alone does not return the new fields; S2's API layer change is independently observable.

iWantTo: receive batch_number and serial_number as separate fields in the stock response
soThat: I can access and display batch and serial information independently without parsing a combined code
